description: Before/after 3D preview: Before = player's save as-is; After = ONLY items you place via home_design_placements (type, x, y, rot per piece). No automatic layout. Call get_home_layout + get_furniture_catalog first. Returns preview_artifact_url and home_design_add_json for apply_home_design.

home_design_max_budget_ngn.description: Cap spend for validation (defaults to player cash).

home_design_placements.description: Required. Each new piece YOU choose: catalog id + grid cell + rotation. Not auto-generated.

type.description: Catalog id from get_furniture_catalog (e.g. kingBed, tv).

x.description: Grid column. Floor 0..grid-1; west wall x=-1.

y.description: Grid row. Floor 0..grid-1; north wall y=-1.

z.description: Optional wall height in 3D preview only.

home_design_placements_json.description: Legacy: same array as JSON string if the host cannot pass arrays. Prefer home_design_placements.

home_design_style.description: bachelor, minimal, luxury, kitchen, power, cozy — label only.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: preview_home_design
